sampling_policy.allocation: target * type_weight / 72; balance within each group
sampling_policy.shortfall_policy: Prioritize underfilled types; record shortages and seek new sources while preserving evidence standards.
sampling_policy.assignment_evidence: Observed component behavior; intended_use and source metadata only guide discovery.
sampling_policy.secondary_types: Retain for retrieval but do not duplicate URL quota credit.

types.requirements:
Implement an advanced data table component with rich functionality.
    Requirements:
    - Display tabular data with sortable columns (click header to sort asc/desc).
    - Add pagination controls (previous/next, page numbers, items per page selector).
    - Implement column filtering with dropdown or text input per column.
    - Support row selection with checkboxes (single and select-all).
    - Add inline editing capability for editable cells.
    - Responsive design: horizontal scroll or card view on mobile.

Implement a WYSIWYG rich text editor component.
    Requirements:
    - Create a toolbar with formatting buttons (Bold, Italic, Underline, Strikethrough).
    - Support heading levels (H1-H3), lists (ordered/unordered), and blockquotes.
    - Implement link insertion with URL input dialog.
    - Add image embedding via URL or placeholder.
    - Use contenteditable div or textarea with preview mode.
    - Sync formatted content to a hidden textarea for form submission.

Implement a drag-and-drop interface for reordering or organizing items.
    Requirements:
    - Create draggable items with visual drag handles.
    - Implement drop zones with visual feedback (highlight on dragover).
    - Support reordering within a single list (Kanban column style).
    - Add cross-container drag support if multiple lists exist.
    - Show placeholder/ghost element during drag operation.
    - Persist order changes to data structure and optionally localStorage.

Implement a hierarchical tree view component for nested data.
    Requirements:
    - Display nested items with expand/collapse toggles (arrows or +/- icons).
    - Support multiple levels of nesting (at least 3 levels deep).
    - Implement lazy loading or virtual rendering for large trees.
    - Add checkbox selection with parent-child cascade (select parent selects all children).
    - Support keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Enter to toggle).
    - Add search/filter functionality to highlight matching nodes.

Implement a real-time dashboard with live-updating metrics.
    Requirements:
    - Create dashboard cards displaying key metrics (numbers, percentages).
    - Simulate real-time data updates using setInterval or mock WebSocket.
    - Add animated counters that smoothly transition between values.
    - Implement mini charts/sparklines showing trend data (use CSS or canvas).
    - Add status indicators (green/yellow/red) based on thresholds.
    - Include a "last updated" timestamp that refreshes automatically.

Implement infinite scroll pagination for a content feed.
    Requirements:
    - Load initial batch of items (e.g., 10-20 items).
    - Detect when user scrolls near bottom using Intersection Observer or scroll event.
    - Fetch and append next batch of items seamlessly.
    - Show loading spinner/skeleton during fetch.
    - Handle end-of-content state with "No more items" message.
    - Implement scroll position restoration on back navigation (optional).

Implement comprehensive async form validation with server-side checks.
    Requirements:
    - Real-time validation on input blur and form submit.
    - Simulate async validation (e.g., username availability check with delay).
    - Show loading spinner next to field during async validation.
    - Display inline error/success messages with appropriate icons.
    - Debounce rapid input to avoid excessive validation calls.
    - Disable submit button while any async validation is pending.

Implement a file upload component with progress tracking.
    Requirements:
    - Create a drag-and-drop zone with click-to-browse fallback.
    - Show file preview (thumbnail for images, icon for others).
    - Display upload progress bar with percentage for each file.
    - Simulate upload progress using XMLHttpRequest or fetch with mock delay.
    - Support multiple file selection and queue management.
    - Add cancel upload and remove file functionality.

Implement parallax scrolling effects for visual depth.
    Requirements:
    - Create multiple layers that move at different speeds on scroll.
    - Apply parallax to background images, floating elements, or text.
    - Use transform: translate3d for GPU-accelerated smooth performance.
    - Implement both vertical and optional horizontal parallax.
    - Add fade-in/scale effects for elements entering viewport.
    - Ensure graceful degradation on mobile (reduce or disable effects).

Implement smooth page/view transitions for SPA-like experience.
    Requirements:
    - Create animated transitions between different content sections/pages.
    - Implement multiple transition types (fade, slide, zoom, flip).
    - Add enter/exit animations that coordinate timing.
    - Use CSS transitions/animations or Web Animations API.
    - Handle browser back/forward with appropriate reverse animations.
    - Add loading state during content fetch if applicable.

Implement interactive particle effects for visual enhancement.
    Requirements:
    - Create a canvas-based particle system with configurable particle count.
    - Implement particle physics (velocity, gravity, friction, bounce).
    - Add mouse/touch interaction (particles follow cursor, explode on click).
    - Support different particle shapes (circles, squares, custom images).
    - Implement connection lines between nearby particles (constellation effect).
    - Optimize performance with requestAnimationFrame and particle pooling.

Implement skeleton loading screens for improved perceived performance.
    Requirements:
    - Create skeleton placeholders matching the layout of actual content.
    - Add shimmer/pulse animation effect on skeleton elements.
    - Implement skeletons for various content types (text, images, cards, lists).
    - Smooth transition from skeleton to actual content when loaded.
    - Support different skeleton variants based on content type.
    - Ensure skeletons are accessible (aria-busy, aria-label).

Implement a fully functional shopping cart system.
    Requirements:
    - Add "Add to Cart" buttons on product items with quantity selector.
    - Create cart sidebar/dropdown showing added items with thumbnails.
    - Implement quantity adjustment (+/-) and remove item functionality.
    - Calculate and display subtotal, tax, and total in real-time.
    - Persist cart data in localStorage across page refreshes.
    - Add cart badge showing item count on cart icon.

Implement a complete user authentication UI flow.
    Requirements:
    - Create login form with email/username and password fields.
    - Create registration form with password confirmation and terms checkbox.
    - Implement "Forgot Password" flow with email input.
    - Add form validation with appropriate error messages.
    - Show/hide password toggle functionality.
    - Simulate auth state with localStorage and update UI accordingly (logged in/out).

Implement a multi-step form wizard with progress tracking.
    Requirements:
    - Create a step indicator showing current step and total steps.
    - Implement step navigation (Next, Previous, Skip if allowed).
    - Validate each step before allowing progression.
    - Show step completion status (completed, current, upcoming).
    - Persist form data across steps (don't lose data on back navigation).
    - Add final review step showing all entered data before submission.

Implement a notification center with real-time alerts.
    Requirements:
    - Create notification bell icon with unread count badge.
    - Implement dropdown panel showing notification list.
    - Support different notification types (info, success, warning, error).
    - Add mark as read (individual and mark all) functionality.
    - Implement notification grouping by date or type.
    - Add simulated real-time notifications using setInterval or mock events.

Implement a dark/light theme switcher using CSS custom properties.
    Requirements:
    - Define CSS variables for background, text, border, and accent colors in :root and [data-theme='dark'].
    - Create a toggle button (sun/moon icon) in the header that switches themes.
    - Apply smooth transition on all color changes (transition: background-color 0.3s, color 0.3s).
    - Persist the user's preference in localStorage.
    - Respect prefers-color-scheme media query as default on first visit.
    - Ensure all page components respond correctly to the theme change.

Implement collapsible accordion panels for organizing content.
    Requirements:
    - Create a list of header/content panel pairs that expand/collapse on header click.
    - Only one panel open at a time (exclusive mode) or allow multiple (configurable).
    - Animate the expand/collapse with smooth height transition (max-height or CSS grid).
    - Show open/close indicator (chevron/plus icon) that rotates on toggle.
    - Support keyboard navigation (Enter/Space to toggle, arrow keys between headers).
    - Add aria-expanded and aria-controls for accessibility.

Implement a modal dialog system with backdrop overlay.
    Requirements:
    - Create a centered modal with semi-transparent backdrop overlay.
    - Close on ESC key press, backdrop click, or close button.
    - Implement focus trap (Tab cycles only within modal while open).
    - Add open/close animation (fade + scale or slide).
    - Prevent body scroll when modal is open (overflow: hidden on body).
    - Support multiple modal sizes (small, medium, large) via CSS classes.

Implement a tooltip/popover component for contextual information.
    Requirements:
    - Show tooltip on hover (with 200ms delay) or focus on trigger element.
    - Position tooltip automatically (top/bottom/left/right) based on available space.
    - Add a small arrow/caret pointing to the trigger element.
    - Support both plain text and rich HTML content in tooltip.
    - Dismiss on mouse leave, blur, ESC, or scroll.
    - Ensure tooltip stays within viewport bounds (flip if necessary).

Implement dynamic breadcrumb navigation reflecting page hierarchy.
    Requirements:
    - Display a horizontal breadcrumb trail showing the current navigation path.
    - Use separator characters (/ or >) between items.
    - Make all items except the last one clickable links.
    - Highlight the current (last) item as non-clickable text.
    - Add structured data (schema.org BreadcrumbList) for SEO.
    - Truncate long paths with ellipsis on mobile (show first, last, and ellipsis).

Implement a tabbed content interface with keyboard accessibility.
    Requirements:
    - Create a horizontal tab bar with multiple tab buttons.
    - Show/hide corresponding tab panels when a tab is clicked.
    - Style the active tab distinctly (border-bottom, background change, or underline).
    - Support keyboard navigation (arrow keys between tabs, Enter/Space to select).
    - Implement proper ARIA roles (tablist, tab, tabpanel) with aria-selected.
    - Add smooth fade or slide transition when switching panels.

Implement an auto-dismissing toast notification system.
    Requirements:
    - Display toast messages at a fixed screen position (top-right or bottom-right).
    - Support multiple types: success (green), error (red), warning (yellow), info (blue).
    - Auto-dismiss after configurable duration (default 5 seconds) with progress bar.
    - Stack multiple toasts vertically with smooth entrance/exit animations.
    - Allow manual dismiss via close button.
    - Pause auto-dismiss timer on hover.

Implement an interactive star rating widget.
    Requirements:
    - Display 5 clickable star icons in a row.
    - Highlight stars on hover to preview the rating (fill stars up to cursor).
    - On click, set the rating and keep stars filled.
    - Support half-star precision (optional).
    - Show numeric rating value next to the stars.
    - Add visual feedback animation on selection (brief scale pulse).
    - Make it accessible with aria-label and keyboard support (arrow keys).

Implement copy-to-clipboard functionality with visual feedback.
    Requirements:
    - Add a copy button next to code blocks or text content.
    - Use navigator.clipboard.writeText() API with fallback for older browsers.
    - Show visual confirmation on copy (icon changes to checkmark, tooltip says 'Copied!').
    - Revert the icon/text back to original state after 2 seconds.
    - Support copying from multiple elements on the same page.
    - Style the button to blend with the content context (inline or floating).

Implement a smooth scroll-to-top button.
    Requirements:
    - Show a floating button (fixed position, bottom-right) when user scrolls down >300px.
    - Hide the button with fade animation when near the top.
    - On click, smoothly scroll to page top using window.scrollTo with behavior: 'smooth'.
    - Add a subtle hover effect (scale or shadow increase).
    - Use an upward arrow icon inside a circular button.
    - Ensure the button doesn't overlap important content (add appropriate z-index).

Implement a GDPR-compliant cookie consent banner.
    Requirements:
    - Display a fixed banner at the bottom of the page on first visit.
    - Include 'Accept All', 'Reject All', and 'Customize' buttons.
    - 'Customize' opens a panel with toggle switches for cookie categories (Essential, Analytics, Marketing).
    - Store the user's choice in localStorage; don't show banner again once decided.
    - Add a small 'Cookie Settings' link in the footer to re-open preferences.
    - Animate the banner entrance (slide up) and exit (slide down).

Implement a responsive navigation with mobile hamburger menu.
    Requirements:
    - On desktop (>768px): show a horizontal nav bar with all menu items visible.
    - On mobile (<=768px): collapse nav into a hamburger icon (three lines).
    - Clicking hamburger opens a full-height sidebar or dropdown with menu items.
    - Animate the menu open/close (slide-in from left or fade-down).
    - Close the menu on link click, outside click, or ESC key.
    - Add smooth transition for the hamburger icon to X (close) transformation.

Implement a sticky header with scroll spy highlighting.
    Requirements:
    - Make the header fixed at the top when scrolling past its natural position.
    - Add a subtle shadow or border-bottom when the header becomes sticky.
    - Implement scroll spy: highlight the nav link corresponding to the currently visible section.
    - Use Intersection Observer to detect which section is in view.
    - Smooth scroll to section when clicking nav links (scroll-behavior or JS).
    - Optionally shrink/transform the header on scroll (smaller height, logo resize).

Implement a search input with dropdown autocomplete suggestions.
    Requirements:
    - Create a search input field with a search icon.
    - Show a dropdown of matching suggestions as the user types.
    - Debounce input to avoid excessive filtering (300ms delay).
    - Highlight the matching text portion in each suggestion.
    - Support keyboard navigation in the dropdown (arrow up/down, Enter to select, ESC to close).
    - Show 'No results found' when no matches; show recent searches when input is empty.

Implement a full-screen image lightbox gallery.
    Requirements:
    - Display a grid/list of thumbnail images that open in lightbox on click.
    - Lightbox shows the full-size image centered on a dark backdrop.
    - Add previous/next navigation arrows to browse through images.
    - Support keyboard navigation (arrow keys, ESC to close).
    - Add smooth zoom/fade animation on open and close.
    - Show image caption and counter (e.g., '3 of 12') below the image.

Implement an animated countdown timer display.
    Requirements:
    - Display days, hours, minutes, and seconds in separate styled boxes.
    - Update every second using setInterval with smooth digit transitions.
    - Add flip or fade animation when digits change.
    - Accept a target date/time as configuration.
    - Show 'Time expired!' or trigger an action when countdown reaches zero.
    - Style with clear visual hierarchy (large numbers, small labels below).

Implement an interactive color picker component.
    Requirements:
    - Create a color spectrum canvas (hue/saturation gradient) for visual selection.
    - Add a hue slider bar for selecting the base hue.
    - Display the selected color as a preview swatch.
    - Show hex, RGB, and HSL values that update in real-time.
    - Allow manual input of hex/RGB values with validation.
    - Add preset color swatches for quick selection.
    - Copy hex value to clipboard on click of the preview swatch.

Implement a calendar-based date picker component.
    Requirements:
    - Create a text input that opens a calendar dropdown on click/focus.
    - Display a month grid with selectable day cells.
    - Add month/year navigation (previous/next arrows, month/year dropdowns).
    - Highlight today's date and the selected date distinctly.
    - Disable dates outside a valid range if configured.
    - Close the calendar on date selection or outside click.
    - Format and display the selected date in the input field.

Implement a content carousel/slider with navigation controls.
    Requirements:
    - Display one slide at a time (or multiple in a row) with smooth horizontal sliding.
    - Add previous/next arrow buttons on the sides.
    - Add dot indicators below showing the current slide position.
    - Support auto-play with configurable interval and pause-on-hover.
    - Implement infinite loop (wrap from last to first slide seamlessly).
    - Add swipe/drag support for touch devices.
    - Ensure smooth CSS transition between slides.

Implement a keyboard shortcuts system with help overlay.
    Requirements:
    - Register global keyboard shortcuts (e.g., Ctrl+K for search, ? for help).
    - Create a help overlay (modal) showing all available shortcuts in a grid.
    - Toggle the help panel with '?' key press.
    - Prevent shortcuts from firing when user is typing in input/textarea fields.
    - Group shortcuts by category (Navigation, Actions, Editing).
    - Show visual key badges (styled kbd elements) next to each shortcut description.

Implement a custom right-click context menu.
    Requirements:
    - Override the default browser context menu on specific elements or the page.
    - Show a styled dropdown menu at the cursor position on right-click.
    - Include menu items with icons, text, and optional keyboard shortcut hints.
    - Support nested submenus (hover to expand).
    - Close the menu on item click, outside click, or ESC.
    - Position the menu to stay within viewport bounds (flip if near edge).

Implement lazy loading for images with placeholder effects.
    Requirements:
    - Defer loading of off-screen images until they enter the viewport.
    - Use Intersection Observer API to detect visibility.
    - Show a blurred low-resolution placeholder or solid color box while loading.
    - Animate the transition from placeholder to full image (fade-in).
    - Add loading='lazy' attribute as progressive enhancement.
    - Handle error state with a fallback broken-image indicator.

Implement an optimized print layout using CSS @media print.
    Requirements:
    - Hide navigation, footer, ads, and interactive elements when printing.
    - Expand all collapsed/accordion content so nothing is hidden.
    - Force a white background with black text for readability and ink saving.
    - Display URLs after links in parentheses (content: ' (' attr(href) ')').
    - Add page-break-inside: avoid on cards, images, and tables.
    - Add a 'Print this page' button that triggers window.print().

Implement an undo/redo system for user actions.
    Requirements:
    - Track user modifications in a history stack (array of state snapshots or commands).
    - Add Undo (Ctrl+Z) and Redo (Ctrl+Shift+Z or Ctrl+Y) keyboard shortcuts.
    - Create visible Undo/Redo buttons in the UI with disabled state when unavailable.
    - Support at least 20 levels of undo history.
    - Clear the redo stack when a new action is performed after undoing.
    - Show a brief indicator or toast when undo/redo is performed.
Add a meaningful click target. The default and clicked states must be visually distinct, the click must update observable DOM/ARIA state, and the surrounding page must remain unchanged.
Add a meaningful hover interaction. Keep the hovered state stable long enough to capture, reveal or change visible content, and provide the same information on keyboard focus.
Add a keyboard-reachable focus interaction with a conspicuous focus indicator and an observable semantic state. Do not use color alone.
Add an input whose typed value changes a visible result, preview, count, or suggestion list. Include empty and populated states and deterministic local data.
Add a select/listbox control whose chosen option visibly updates related content. Include a stable default option and at least two deterministic alternatives.
Add an accessible binary toggle with visibly different on/off states, correct aria-checked or aria-pressed state, and deterministic local persistence when appropriate.
Add a tab switch with distinct panels, active styling, click and arrow-key support, and observable aria-selected state.
Add a dropdown/menu with closed, open, selected, and dismissed states. Support click, keyboard operation, outside click, and Escape.
Add deterministic ascending and descending sorting. The visible order and active sort direction must both change after activation.
Add a deterministic filter that changes the visible result set, result count, and active-filter indicator, including a no-results or reset path.
Add deterministic pagination with previous/next and page selection. The visible item slice and current-page indicator must change.
Add same-origin navigation between existing project pages. The destination must visibly differ, links must work over local HTTP, and a return path must preserve relevant local state.
Add form validation with invalid and valid paths, accessible inline messages, visible error/success states, and submission prevention until valid.
Add a user-controlled condition that inserts, removes, or replaces a meaningful visible region while preserving unrelated content.
Add a deterministic, capturable loading state followed by a settled success or empty result. Do not depend on a real backend or remote timer source.
Add a user-triggered animation with deterministic before and after keyframes, reduced-motion handling, and a stable final state suitable for screenshots.
